pH.name: pH
pH.description: Measures the acidity or alkalinity of water.

TDS.name: Total Dissolved Solids
TDS.description: Represents the amount of dissolved substances present in water.

turbidity.name: Turbidity
turbidity.description: Indicates the cloudiness of water caused by suspended particles.

interpretation.high: Water has increased cloudiness due to suspended particles.

temperature.name: Water Temperature
temperature.description: Represents the measured temperature of the water.

interpretation.moderate: Water temperature is within a moderate range.

temperature.usage: Used as a monitored parameter and as an input to the deep learning model. No project-specific drinking-water safety threshold is assigned.
